measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the town to transfer up to 30 acres of its 308-acre Raptor Lane property to support construction of up to 35 housing units.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed transfer of up to 30 acres for up to 35 housing units.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed land-transfer authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require all town appropriations to be decided by Australian ballot, a secret-ballot vote, effective January 1, 2027 and beginning with fiscal year 2027–2028.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve using Australian ballot for all town appropriations on that schedule.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change in the voting method for town appropriations.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Bennington to issue up to $5 million in bonds or notes to upgrade and improve its wastewater treatment facility. The estimated project cost is $5 million, and federal or state grants and reserve funds would reduce the amount borrowed.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $5 million in wastewater-facility borrowing, reduced by applicable grants and reserve funds.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed wastewater-facility borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize three local taxes in one proposal: 1% on taxable sales, 1% on meals and alcoholic beverages, and 1% on rooms. The Vermont Department of Taxes would collect and administer these taxes under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve all three proposed 1% local option taxes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this combined proposal for the three local option taxes.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Williston to issue up to $9 million in general-obligation bonds or notes to renovate and expand the Dorothy Alling Memorial Library and make associated improvements. The borrowing would pay capital and related project costs and would be reduced by grants and other town funds available for the project.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the library project and up to $9 million in borrowing, reduced by available grants and town funds.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed library project and borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Decide all Underhill budget articles by Australian ballot, a secret-ballot vote.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve deciding all town budget articles by Australian ballot.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change in the voting method for budget articles.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize a 1% local option tax on taxable retail sales, with half of the town’s receipts dedicated to municipal property-tax relief. The state would collect the tax and return 75% to the town after administration and collection costs; the Select Board would decide uses for the town’s other half of receipts each year. These receipts would be available for municipal expenses and municipal property-tax relief. Because the questions were warned late, approval would require a second validation vote before the tax could take effect. The town anticipates that vote in March 2027 and would need to give the Department of Taxes at least 90 days’ notice before collection.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% tax on taxable retail sales and its municipal property-tax dedication, subject to the required later validation vote.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local option tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize a 1% local option tax on meals and alcoholic beverages, with half of the town’s receipts dedicated to municipal property-tax relief. The state would collect the tax and return 75% to the town after administration and collection costs; the Select Board would decide uses for the town’s other half of receipts each year. These receipts would be available for municipal expenses and municipal property-tax relief. For meals and alcohol, the town says this covers alcohol consumed at a restaurant or bar; store purchases for home consumption fall under retail sales. Because the questions were warned late, approval would require a second validation vote before the tax could take effect. The town anticipates that vote in March 2027 and would need to give the Department of Taxes at least 90 days’ notice before collection.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% tax on meals and alcoholic beverages and its municipal property-tax dedication, subject to the required later validation vote.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local option tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize a 1% local option tax on rooms, with half of the town’s receipts dedicated to municipal property-tax relief. The state would collect the tax and return 75% to the town after administration and collection costs; the Select Board would decide uses for the town’s other half of receipts each year. These receipts would be available for municipal expenses and municipal property-tax relief. Because the questions were warned late, approval would require a second validation vote before the tax could take effect. The town anticipates that vote in March 2027 and would need to give the Department of Taxes at least 90 days’ notice before collection.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% tax on rooms and its municipal property-tax dedication, subject to the required later validation vote.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local option tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Westford to issue up to $472,500 in general-obligation bonds or notes to buy and equip a fire tanker truck. Money from the Fire Department Equipment Reserve Fund would reduce the borrowing. The ballot describes the maximum repayment term as ten years, “more or less.”
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed fire tanker borrowing of up to $472,500, reduced by equipment-reserve funds, with the repayment term described in the ballot.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed fire tanker borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize Hinesburg to assess a 1% local option tax on taxable sales under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% local sales tax.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local sales tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize Hinesburg to assess a 1% local option tax on rooms under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% local rooms tax.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local rooms tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize Hinesburg to assess a 1% local option tax on meals and alcohol under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed 1% local meals and alcohol tax.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local meals and alcohol tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Ask residents to choose their preferred Town Meeting time as input on accessibility for the Select Board. The four choices are a weekday evening, Saturday morning, keeping the first Tuesday in March at 10 a.m., or saying they would not attend regardless of the time.
Have people attending Town Meeting elect all town officers by a vote from the floor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve electing all town officers from the floor at Town Meeting.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed voting method for electing town officers.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Have people attending Town Meeting decide all town budget articles by a vote from the floor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve deciding all town budget articles from the floor at Town Meeting.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed voting method for town budget articles.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Have people attending Town Meeting decide all town public questions by a vote from the floor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve deciding all public questions from the floor at Town Meeting.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed voting method for public questions.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Ask voters whether to recommend that the Select Board adopt an ordinance allowing all-terrain vehicles and utility task vehicles on some town roads. The question asks for a recommendation to the board.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Recommend that the Select Board adopt an ordinance allowing those vehicles on some town roads.
measureRecords.noMeans: Decline to recommend that proposed ordinance.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the Rutland City school board to establish and control a capital reserve fund for improvements at Rutland City public school sites.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve creating the school capital improvements reserve fund under the school board’s control.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject creating this proposed school capital reserve fund.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempt the property at 113 Library Avenue, owned by Habitat for Humanity of Rutland County, from property taxes for up to ten years beginning with tax year 2026–2027. The exemption would apply only while Habitat uses the property exclusively for its nonprofit charitable purpose of providing affordable housing, under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed property-tax exemption for up to ten years under those ownership and use conditions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed property-tax exemption.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the Select Board to borrow up to $855,000 for no more than ten years to buy a fire pumper truck.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $855,000 in borrowing for the fire pumper truck, repayable within ten years.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed fire pumper borrowing authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize cannabis retailers and the retail portions of integrated-license cannabis establishments to operate in Royalton under the state law named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve allowing the cannabis retail businesses described in the question.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed authorization for cannabis retail businesses.
